newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains up on stg, May and July head volume.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains up on stg, May and July head volume.

text.p: LIFFE wheat firmed, helped up by a faltering sterling, traders said.
With the first tender day for May wheat on Thursday, May and July led volume as holders got out of the front month, they said.
July was the most active contract on wheat, with 266 lots of a total 664 traded. It last changed hands 0.90 stg higher at 100.65 stg.
There were smaller rises for new crop months, with November last traded 0.25 stg higher at 98.75 stg.
Just six lots of barley were traded, with five on November, which last traded unchanged at 97.00 stg.
